verdict: Paid ads remain paused; organic holding but softening this week.
narrative: All paid activity has been off for the full 28-day period, meaning every visit and call you received came through organic channels alone. Your Google Business Profile drove 176 actions this period — 54 phone calls and 122 website clicks — but that activity dropped 30% in the most recent week, a pattern consistent with reduced paid support amplifying your organic presence. Search visibility also softened, with clicks down roughly 20% week over week. Resuming paid ads is gated on the contract extension being signed, and once that is in place, Meta campaigns are ready to relaunch at their prior daily budget. You should expect lead volume to remain low until paid channels are back online.
